verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is a recruiting platform with workflow automation, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The pack only shows adjacent features: a pricing-page 'Audit log' line item and a 'Developer sandbox & sync'. Neither is documented as versioning, review or rollback of automations, and an audit log or sandbox is not version control or rollback, so this is no support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
